form: FNS062 Department of Revenue Fiscal Note

templates.name: No fiscal impact
templates.description: No cash receipts and no expenditures. Part I marks No Fiscal Impact; Parts III-V are NONE or blank. Modeled on HB 1126 (packageID 71578) and HB 2681 EHB (77479).

templates.name: Indeterminate cash receipts
templates.description: Cash receipts are non-zero but cannot be estimated. Part I shows the FNS indeterminate sentence; II.B gives an illustrative figure and states Indeterminate for state and local. Modeled on HB 1094 (packageID 71723).

templates.name: B&O tax rate or classification change
templates.description: Rate or classification change under chapter 82.04 RCW with receipts split between GF-State and the Workforce Education Investment Account; Ten-Year Analysis attached for increases. Modeled on HB 1320 (72144), HB 2081 ESHB .PL (74998), HB 2020 (73978).

templates.name: Sales and use tax exemption (new tax preference)
templates.description: New exemption under chapters 82.08/82.12 RCW. GF-State and Performance Audits rows, local series at the statewide average local rate, sales tax lag assumptions, tribal compact sentence, tax preference performance statement and expiration. Modeled on HB 1318 (72508), HB 1751 (72573), HB 1924 (73951).

templates.name: Property tax exemption or levy change
templates.description: Property tax bill under Title 84 RCW. Distinguishes revenue loss from tax shift, reports state and local impact on a fiscal year basis and a calendar year detail block, and uses the $3.60 state levy limit assumption. Modeled on HB 1004 (71461) and HB 1334 (72718).

templates.name: Real estate excise tax change
templates.description: REET under chapter 82.45 RCW. Receipts across GF-State, Public Works Assistance Account, and Education Legacy Trust Account; local impact from county administrative fees; REET forecast growth and CPI threshold indexing. Modeled on HB 2227 (75694, revised 76754).

templates.name: Local sales tax authority credited against the state tax
templates.description: New local option sales and use tax under chapter 82.14 RCW credited against the 6.5% state rate: state decrease, equal local increase net of the Performance Audits share, one- and two-month lag, all jurisdictions assumed to impose. Modeled on HB 1100 (73919) and HB 1896 (73303).

templates.name: Tax credit with a per-taxpayer cap
templates.description: New B&O (or PUT) credit with an annual cap per business, application and approval process, carry-forward, earn-through and expiration dates. Population is stratified with eligibility and utilization rates. Modeled on HB 1895 (73150).

templates.name: Administrative cost only (no revenue impact)
templates.description: Bill changes administration, reporting, or a preference that does not change taxable income. Receipts NONE with a one-sentence reason; expenditures for system changes, notices, rule making, and taxpayer service. Modeled on HB 1993 (74046) and HB 1376 (73036).

templates.name: Tax preference expiration or repeal
templates.description: Repeal or narrowing of an existing exemption, deduction, or credit: revenue increase, compliance-rate assumptions by taxpayer group, value from the Tax Exemption Study where applicable, Ten-Year Analysis attached because the bill raises taxes under RCW 43.135.034. Modeled on HB 1284 (72136) and HB 2081 Part IV (74998).

templates.name: Fee imposition or increase (RCW 43.135.055)
templates.description: New or increased fee. Fee-payer count times fee change with proration and CPI indexing; Ten-Year Analysis with a descriptive fee title and three-character account code (NEW for a new account); local-only variant leaves state receipts None. Modeled on HB 1044 (71440) and the OFM ten-year rules; no DOR-administered state fee note was found in the sample.

templates.name: Revised note or note on a substitute/engrossed bill
templates.description: Note created from a prior version. Opens with the version note sentence and a COMPARISON section, then carries the prior narrative forward. Two note forms: revision of the same bill version ("replaces fiscal note number") and new bill version ("reflects language in"). Modeled on HB 2020 SHB (74852), HB 2227 revised (76754), HB 2081 ESHB .PL (74998), HB 2681 EHB (77479).
